serverInfo.name: Dreeve
serverInfo.description: Read-only access to the activities, metrics and settings of a self-hosted Dreeve instance.

result.instructions:
Dreeve is a self-hosted app that holds one athlete's sport activities, imported from Strava or from files.
Tools accept identifiers with or without their type prefix, for example "activity-123" or "123".
Dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format.
Field names state their unit, for example "distanceInKilometer". Splits follow the unit system the instance is configured with.
Every tool is read-only.
